Mykolaiv Oblast Drought Assessment (2000-2025)

Season: April-September | Grid: MODIS 250 m | Indicators: water balance (ERA5-Land rain minus potential evaporation) and MODIS NDVI, on farmland only.

Classes describe how unusual each year is compared with the same place in 2000-2025 (a standardised combined anomaly). Because every place is compared with its own history, a place is Moderate-or-worse in roughly one year in six by construction; look for years when a large share is affected at once. Years 2022-2025 (italic) are war years: NDVI there may also reflect abandoned or mined fields.

Severity classes

None (<0.5σ) Mild (0.5-1σ) Moderate (1-1.5σ) Severe (1.5-2σ) Extreme (≥2σ) No farmland
